svg.title: Simulation speed in 0.1.3 and 0.2.2
svg.desc: Both dates used the same 25 inputs and Icarus build. 0.1.3 wins on 25 inputs with a geometric mean of 2.37×. 0.2.2 wins on 23 inputs with a geometric mean of 2.25×.

g.text: Each series uses its own day’s Icarus Δ / kirimasim Δ. Outside 1×, kirimasim is faster. Each ring doubles the ratio.
